description: Real-world migration: 3 nodes with plugin (25.12/26.5), 2 nodes without plugin (25.12/26.5). Pre-deployed genesis contracts. Validates cross-version consensus + bypass on transparent nodes.

contracts._comment: Contracts deployed at runtime via setup_script on node without plugin (validador-1). Dynamic addresses.

nodes._comment: Legacy bootnode — Besu 25.12.0, WITHOUT plugin. Produces blocks (admin key = validator genesis). Used for contract deployment (port 9001). Represents pre-migration node.
nodes.name: validador-1

nodes._comment: Migrated validator — Besu 26.5.0, WITH permissioning plugin active. Applies on-chain permissioning.
nodes.name: validador-2

nodes._comment: Transparent validator — Besu 26.5.0, WITHOUT plugin. Represents node not yet migrated. Transactions to this node skip permissioning.
nodes.name: validador-3

nodes._comment: Migrated validator — Besu 26.5.0, WITH plugin. Second node with plugin to validate consistency between plugin nodes.
nodes.name: validador-4

nodes._comment: Public RPC — Besu 26.5.0, WITH plugin. External access point that MUST enforce permissioning.
nodes.name: rpc-node-1
